jon-rahm:2025-05-13.lede: Six bags deep into the Callaway era and the Odyssey Ai-ONE Rossie S has not moved. That putter has been in play since the 2024 snapshot, replacing the White Hot OG Rossie S that ran from 2021 through 2023. The current setup pairs the Elyte Triple Diamond at 10.5 degrees with an Apex UT 21, an Apex Pro 4-iron, and Apex TCB from 5 through pitching wedge. The Chrome Tour is the ball.
jon-rahm:2025-05-13.history_narrative: The 2019 and 2020 snapshots show a full TaylorMade bag built around the M5 then SIM driver, P750 irons, Spider X, and TP5. By early 2021 the bag was full Callaway, anchored by the Apex TCB irons and an Epic Speed Triple Diamond, with the driver cycling through Rogue ST and Paradym Triple Diamond builds across 2022 and 2023. The 2024 snapshot added the Apex UT and Apex Pro long irons and swapped in the Ai-ONE Rossie S, and the current 2025 bag carries that mixed iron set behind the Elyte Triple Diamond and Chrome Tour.
